description: This file defines the Startup class within the Opencart"Catalog\Model\Setting" namespace. The class interacts with the database to retrieve startup records with a status of '1', ordered by 'sort_order'. It is a model class meant for use within the Opencart framework, specifically for managing startup entries in the settings module.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: A model class to retrieve active startup records from the database.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Retrieves startup records with status '1' from the database, returning them as an array.
